title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.13.2 and v0.13.3: badge rows now sit on the centre of their frame - the backing's insets were asymmetric, which put every row 11px left of where it looked like it should be. The captioned top panels carry a wider minimum, so a one-relic Setup Relics bar is still a billboard. The development log breadcrumbs are gone; the mod is silent unless something fails.
